_readme: Add an app by copying the item marked "template": true, pasting it into this "items" array, filling it in, and removing the "template": true line. (If the file is repo-hosted, commit it under /downloads/ or another folder build.sh copies into dist/.)
A download 'url' can be a repo-relative path (e.g. /downloads/MyApp-1.2.0.exe) OR a full external URL (e.g. https://github.com/you/app/releases/download/...).

An item with "template": true renders as a non-clickable TEMPLATE reference card at the bottom of the page and is excluded from search/sort/filter and the count. Keys starting with '_' are ignored entirely.
Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). 'updated' drives the Newest/Oldest sort; the newest changelog entry should match the current 'version'. Set "featured": true to pin an app to the top with a badge.

items.name: Lyric Chunker
items.tagline: Blender add-on + Fusion comp generator for the music visualizer pipeline
items.description: Type delimited lyrics, get styled 3D text split into per-syllable chunk objects, batch-render each chunk as a transparent 16-bit PNG with a JSON timing manifest per line, then generate a pasteable Fusion node graph (color-flip + bounce, timed from the manifest) for DaVinci Resolve. The bundle zip has both tools; the add-on installs via Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install from Disk, the comp generator runs with plain Python 3.

notes: Add reactor elements: images that bounce on chunk timing (LyricChunker@b599f03)
Add Tap Timing, viewport timing preview, and a Resolve build script (LyricChunker@ea91f25)
Let the untimed cascade be set in frames as well as seconds (LyricChunker@7b5bd32)
Expose the untimed cascade length in the Timing panel (LyricChunker@df89acf)
Pin each comp Loader to its own frame of the detected sequence (LyricChunker@2e89c45)
Cascade untimed lines across a default span in generated comps (LyricChunker@e867b39)
Premultiply Loader alpha to kill edge fringing in comps (LyricChunker@c9516a9)
Serialize comp Loaders the way Fusion saves them (LyricChunker@4890677)
Hold comp Loader stills far past the line span (LyricChunker@45e45e7)
Generate Fusion comps from a panel button, no terminal needed (LyricChunker@ffa7497)
Show the full selected lyric line wrapped under the panel list (LyricChunker@52396dc)
Type lyric lines straight into the panel with a browsable line list (LyricChunker@16f9463)
Ship the comp generator alongside the add-on as a downloads bundle (LyricChunker@5470c22)
Bake the project house style into the default template (LyricChunker@b763031)
First release on the downloads hub.
Syllable-chunk generation from delimited lyric lines with template-based styling.
Batch renders each chunk as a transparent 16-bit PNG, per-line output folders.
